rules: Use this file only to choose what to read next.
Detailed specifications remain in their canonical Markdown pages.
Treat implementation progress separately from specification status.
For current-milestone or next-step decisions, read currentMilestone.source and parallelMilestone.source before identifying the active design boundary.
P0 is an independent preflight milestone and may advance out of D/A order when doing so reduces high-cost rework.
For P0 continuation, read the currentStep source or the completed P0 child pages before reopening an already completed preflight decision.
For application progress, verify implementationProgress and the current untold-game main branch before assigning or completing an A milestone.
For next-step decisions, check decisionInbox, then verify the candidate topic in its canonical source through ai-index.json.
Follow linked continuation sources to the latest confirmed handoff before proposing a new design decision.
